# TOML reader

`tomli/` is the unmodified pure-Python implementation from Tomli 2.2.1, by
Taneli Hukkinen: https://github.com/hukkin/tomli/tree/2.2.1 . Its MIT license is
included at `tomli/LICENSE`. It runs only on the build host, never on the IIgs.
Python 3.11+ uses `tomllib` instead; this fallback keeps Python 3.9/3.10 usable
without an installer or a network connection.

Source distribution: `tomli-2.2.1-py3-none-any.whl` from PyPI.
SHA-256: `cb55c73c5f4408779d0cf3eef9f762b9c9f147a77de7b258bef0a5628adc85cc`.
Only package source, its type marker and license are included.
